structure.unit: Fisheries and Habitat of the Tidal Waters
Taking of Fish, Net, and Device Restrictions

law.catch_line: Trotline prohibited on ocean side of Eastern Shore; penalty
law.text: It shall be unlawful to set a fish trotline on the ocean side of the Counties of Accomack and Northampton. The Commission officers may seize any fish trotline set in such an area. A violation of this section is a Class 3 misdemeanor.
